details:
I have a couple requests in terms of features 
-   in-game blacklisting system to keep problematic players from using your content as a creator (this could also help out with widely known community disturbances using a community's hub, like crashers, rippers or bullies)
-   a way to manually set ik values for hip max hip / neck angle bending, in hopes of eliminating crazy neck folding 
-   lobby text chat, with reasonable filters for inappropriate words / links, with options to have sub chats or threats in said text chat (I feel this would help out a lot with deaf and mute/selectively mute players)
-   in-game dming system to dm your friends, again with reasonable filters
-   I already sent this in general but an avatar searching tab to search via keywords/user id
-   Even more favorites?? Sorry to sound gluttonous- you could even put it behind a paywall (or even unlimited favorites as a feature, behind a paywall probably)
-   a way to show dynamic bones/physbones for specific trust ranks (ex., only being able to see the physbones of friends)
If any of these are already implemented and I'm just dense please let me know
title: [Feature Request(s)] A list of ideas I had
